name: Gästehaus Lukasser
beschreibung: Gästehaus Lukasser is located in beautiful Tyrol, Austria. The house offers a serene, peaceful, and unhurried atmosphere. Guests are provided with comfortable yet delightfully understated accommodations. The surroundings showcase the quintessential Tyrolean alpine scenery, with scenic walking trails and recreational nature spots right at your doorstep. Room amenities include en-suite private bathrooms and satellite television. A varied breakfast buffet is freshly prepared each morning. Its prime location makes it an ideal base for discovering the region's top sights.
